t4_motion_canvas.decision: DEFERRED (documented per partner: 'قالب واحد أو تأجيل موثق')
t4_motion_canvas.reason: Motion Canvas is a TypeScript-based animation framework that requires dedicated template development. Given the timebox (half day) and the fact that BookForge's Shorts (T2) use MoneyPrinterTurbo (G6 MIT) for video assembly, Motion Canvas is deferred to v2 for custom motion graphics templates. The deferral is documented — not a failure.
t4_motion_canvas.future_path: When BookForge needs custom motion graphics (beyond MoneyPrinterTurbo's capabilities), Motion Canvas (MIT) is the recommended tool — TypeScript-native, matches BookForge's stack
